info.title: Brainstorm School Management API
info.description: School Management System API. Implemented endpoints: Authentication, People (Headmaster, Teacher, Student), Academics (Sessions, Terms, Classes, Subjects), Grades, Academic Relationships (Enrollments, Class-Subjects, Teaching Assignments), Classroom (Periods, Timetable, Attendance, Assignments). See the guide/ docs for the full planned surface.
